critical_code_review_comments: PreferencesPage.tsx (116 lines) — Clean small file. Correct GET-then-PATCH pattern with local state, disabled Save button while saving, aria-pressed on the toggle for a11y. Loading placeholder has its own testid. Uses toast.error on load/save failures.

PromptDialog.tsx (161 lines) — Solid provider+hook implementation. Promise-returning API mirrors native window.prompt. Radix Dialog with correct z-index (100/101), Escape+overlay-click resolve as cancel, Enter submits (single-line only), required-flag blocks confirm on empty. Both text and multiline supported. All expected data-testids present (prompt-dialog, prompt-dialog-input, prompt-dialog-confirm, prompt-dialog-cancel, prompt-dialog-title, prompt-dialog-description).

AdminCertificatesPage.tsx — Bulk toolbar has correct active-vs-revoked partitioning (selectedActiveIds vs selectedRevokedIds drive disabled prop). All 4 buttons have unique data-testids matching the spec. Revoke flow now correctly chains PromptDialog → ConfirmDialog. Zero window.prompt( calls remain — verified by pytest grep sweep.

compliance_report_worker.py — Clean env-driven design. Empty COMPLIANCE_OFFICER_EMAIL returns {'sent':0,'reason':'no_recipient'} (test verified). Cadence parsing exports _cadence() with weekly fallback for garbage values. Queues single OutboxMessage with template='cert_compliance_report' — correct outbox pattern re-used from other workers.
services/outbox_worker.py — Scheduler registration for compliance worker at lines ~290-310 wires into the existing periodic scheduler (verified via reference — not directly invoked in these tests).

streak_digest_worker.py — Now correctly filters admins by User.streak_digest_enabled==True (line 101). Direct-import smoke test in test_streak_digest_worker_honours_opt_out passes and confirms the column exists on the User model.
DATABASE_URL is now the absolute path sqlite:////app/backend/ifpi_lms.db — the paper-cut flagged in iter30 report is resolved; pytest now runs correctly from any cwd.
docs/IFPI_WEBHOOK_EVENTS.md — Present and documents all 3 required cert events + X-IFPI-Signature header with sha256 HMAC. Grep-tested in test_webhook_events_doc_exists.
